verdict.rationale: Exa documents a single-API research flow. The Exa Agent / Deep Search does iterative search, reasoning, and grounded synthesis with citations and schema-validated JSON (exa-docs-25, exa-docs-45, exa-docs-47). Search returns page contents and highlights in the same request (exa-docs-22, exa-docs-35, exa-docs-36), and agents can trigger `agent_run` multi-step research via MCP (exa-docs-50). Community feedback praises the search API for agentic use (exa-comm-3), but hands-on Websets reports show weak precision and slow verification (exa-comm-1, exa-comm-4), so the depth of quality is not proven. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Agent/Deep Search synthesis quality, and evidence that addresses the reported accuracy and latency problems in the related Websets search-verify-enrich flow.
